meta.name: understand-diff
meta.description: Use when you need to analyze git diffs or pull requests to understand what changed, affected components, and risks

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析代码变更，理解影响与风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要审查代码变更或理解他人提交的影响
copy.tagline_en: Analyze code changes to understand impact and risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to review code changes or understand the impact of others' commits

howto.what: 它会拿当前 git 改动或 PR 的文件列表，对照知识图谱文件，找出直接改动的组件、一跳内受影响的组件和架构层，给出风险评估，并写入 diff-overlay.json 供 dashboard 展示。
howto.when: 当你要分析 git diff 或 pull request、了解改了什么和风险时触发；若知识图谱文件不存在，它会先让你运行 /understand。

say.text: 帮我分析当前改动，看看影响了哪些组件
say.note: 对照知识图谱输出改动与受影响组件

say.text: 用知识图谱分析这个 PR 的影响范围和风险
say.note: 给出受影响架构层和风险评估

say.text: 分析 main...HEAD 的改动，哪些要重点 review

howto.what_en: It takes the changed file list from the current git diff or PR, matches it against the knowledge graph, reports changed and 1-hop affected components, affected layers and risks, and writes diff-overlay.json for the dashboard.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to analyze a git diff or pull request to see what changed and what's at risk. If the knowledge graph file is missing, it asks you to run /understand first.

say_en.text: Analyze my current changes and tell me which components are affected
Use the knowledge graph to analyze this PR's impact and risks
say_en.note: Lists affected layers and a risk assessment

say_en.text: Analyze main...HEAD and flag what to review carefully
